item.title: Critical SonicWall SMA1000 SSRF zero day CVE-2026-102255 actively exploited in the wild within two days of disclosure
item.description:
Threat monitoring sensor networks confirm active wild exploitation targeting a maximum severity server-side request forgery vulnerability in secure access gateways. Unauthenticated remote adversaries actively exploit alternate access routing handlers to bypass perimeter firewall controls and execute unauthorized administrative operations.
The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-102255 with a maximum CVSS score of 10.0, affects SonicWall SMA1000 series appliances running models 6210, 7210, and 8200v. The defect stems from an unauthenticated server-side request forgery handling flaw within the SMA Work Place web interface. Unauthenticated remote adversaries transmit crafted HTTP requests to force the gateway appliance to forge internal network calls, reaching unexposed internal management functions and taking control of vulnerable appliances. Sensor telemetry detected initial exploitation probes reaching active decoy nodes within 48 hours of vendor disclosure.
Subverting secure mobile access gateways destroys internal network isolation and perimeter access controls. Because SMA1000 appliances manage remote SSL VPN access and internal web proxies, an unauthenticated server-side request forgery exploit allows threat actors to map internal network subnets and manipulate internal microservices.
- Upgrade SonicWall SMA1000 series appliances immediately to patched firmware releases 12.5.0-03082 or 12.4.3-03670. - Restrict public internet visibility of SMA1000 web management portals, placing control plane interfaces on isolated management VLANs. - Inspect gateway HTTP access logs for anomalous URI routing targets or malformed Work Place interface request parameters. - Invalidate active remote access VPN sessions and execute mandatory administrative credential rotations across managed gateway fleets.
Perimeter gateway security demands rigid URI path validation and prompt patch deployment to ensure secure access controllers remain shielded from active server-side request forgery attacks. #CodeDefence #SonicWall #SMA1000 #SSRF #ZeroTrust #PerimeterSecurity #NetworkSecurity #AppSec #PatchManagement

item.title: GitLab issues emergency security updates for maximum severity CI CD compiler RCE flaw CVE-2026-92810
item.description:
DevOps software maintainers have distributed emergency security updates to resolve a maximum severity remote code execution vulnerability in continuous integration pipelines. Unauthenticated remote actors can execute arbitrary system commands on build runner nodes during job execution.
The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-92810 with a CVSS score of 9.9, affects self-hosted GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition installations. The defect resides within regular expression parsing subroutines used by the CI CD pipeline configuration compiler. Unauthenticated remote adversaries transmit crafted configuration files or pull requests containing malformed regular expression strings, breaking compiler execution boundaries to run arbitrary system commands with elevated process privileges on underlying server nodes. Official security bulletins urge self-hosted administrators to apply patched release builds immediately.
Subverting continuous integration build pipelines introduces severe software supply chain exposure across enterprise software development environments. Because CI CD build runners possess deployment certificates, repository secrets, and direct access to production cloud environments, an unauthenticated host takeover enables threat actors to exfiltrate build secrets and poison production software releases.
- Upgrade self-hosted GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition instances to official patched release builds immediately. - Gate public internet access to GitLab CI CD runner endpoints using zero trust conditional access proxies. - Inspect continuous integration build runner execution logs for unverified regular expression compilation errors or anomalous process spawns. - Rotate repository deployment keys, API integration tokens, and cloud credentials processed within build automation pipelines.
DevOps platform defense demands rapid dependency patch execution and strict compiler input sanitization to ensure continuous integration build runners remain protected against unauthenticated command execution. #CodeDefence #GitLab #DevSecOps #SupplyChain #CI_CD #RCE #AppSec #PatchManagement

item.title: CyberXero threat group uses automated Claude Code scripts to exfiltrate over 628k Ukrainian database records
item.description:
Cyber threat intelligence writeups published today detail high-velocity cyber espionage campaigns leveraging automated artificial intelligence development scripts. Threat actors deployed autonomous code generation agents to automate database reconnaissance, vulnerability exploitation, and data exfiltration.
The cyber espionage activity, attributed to threat group CyberXero, targeted public sector and municipal infrastructure across Ukraine. Adversaries integrated Claude Code automated development agents created by Anthropic into custom attack toolkits. The AI agents autonomously parsed SQL database structures, bypassed web application firewall rules, and exfiltrated more than 628,000 sensitive records containing personal information and municipal service registries. Threat telemetry confirms AI agents accelerated data extraction timelines from days to hours.
Weaponizing automated AI coding frameworks drastically reduces the operational overhead required for large-scale data exfiltration. As threat actors adopt autonomous AI agents to parse complex application environments, security teams face significantly compressed intrusion timelines to detect and contain active network breaches.
- Deploy real-time database activity monitoring to flag high-volume unverified SQL data queries originating from web application tiers. - Enforce strict microsegmentation between public web portals and backend database servers handling sensitive citizen records. - Implement automated API threat detection to identify high-velocity request patterns characteristic of AI agent automation. - Restrict non-human service account access to database management utilities and enforce strict query rate-limiting controls.
Enterprise data governance requires real-time database auditing and AI-driven behavioral monitoring to ensure sensitive database repositories remain protected against automated exfiltration toolkits. #CodeDefence #Anthropic #Claude #CyberXero #AISecurity #DataExfiltration #ThreatIntelligence #AppSec #DatabaseSecurity
